mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.mail_id, m.sender_id, sender.username AS sender_name, sender.email AS sender_email, m.subject, CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(IFNULL(m.content, '')) > 50 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(m.content, 50), '...') ELSE m.content END AS preview, mr.is_read, m.has_attachment, mr.receive_time, m.send_time, m.priority, m.is_spam FROM mail_star ms JOIN mail m ON ms.mail_id = m.mail_id JOIN `user` sender ON m.sender_id = sender.user_id LEFT JOIN mail_receiver mr ON mr.mail_id = m.mail_id AND mr.receiver_id = #{userId} WHERE ms.user_id = #{userId} AND m.mail_status = 1 AND ( (m.sender_id = #{userId} AND m.sender_deleted = FALSE) OR (mr.receiver_id = #{userId} AND mr.is_deleted = FALSE) ) ORDER BY m.send_time DESC
